completion_promises.criterion_text: Unit test: on_command invoked with _adapter_ready.is_set() == False returns ResultPayload(success=False, error=...) with a clear 'not ready' message; underlying handler is NOT invoked.
completion_promises.evidence: Added the readiness gate at the top of CommandRouter.on_command (after event_type check + payload parse, before dispatch): when self._adapter_ready is set and not is_set(), publish a ResultPayload(success=False, command=payload.command, result={'error': 'study-tutor adapter is not ready', 'error_type': 'AdapterNotReadyError'}, correlation_id=correlation_id) via _publish_result, increment self.not_ready_count, and return without invoking _dispatch_command. Pinned by tests/unit/adapters/test_command_router_readiness.py::test_on_command_when_not_ready_returns_failure_result which asserts (a) mcp_adapter.tutor_start_session/tutor_turn/tutor_session_status/tutor_session_end are NOT awaited, (b) published.success is False, (c) 'not ready' substring present in result['error'], (d) error_type == 'AdapterNotReadyError'.

completion_promises.criterion_text: Unit test: same on_command invocation when _adapter_ready.is_set() == True proceeds normally.
completion_promises.evidence: The gate is a guard, not a permanent block: when adapter_ready.is_set() returns True the gate falls through to the existing _dispatch_command path. Pinned by tests/unit/adapters/test_command_router_readiness.py::test_on_command_when_ready_dispatches_normally which sets adapter_ready, sends a tutor_start_session command, and asserts mcp_adapter.tutor_start_session.assert_awaited_once_with(student_id='lilymay'). Backwards-compat case (no event wired at all) covered by test_router_without_adapter_ready_event_skips_gate.

completion_promises.criterion_text: The Bug #1 reply path is honoured even in the not-ready case (caller still gets a clean reply on the inbox, not a hung future).
completion_promises.evidence: The not-ready branch routes its failure ResultPayload through self._publish_result(reply_to, not_ready_result, correlation_id) — the same dual-publish helper used by the success and unsupported-command paths. Pinned by tests/unit/adapters/test_command_router_readiness.py::test_on_command_not_ready_with_reply_to_dual_publishes which asserts (a) client.publish_raw is awaited once with '_INBOX.notready' and a body that parses as ResultPayload(success=False) with correlation_id='corr-42', AND (b) client.publish is awaited once with subject 'agents.result.gcse-tutor' and a ResultPayload(success=False). nc.request() callers (jarvis) therefore resolve cleanly with a structured failure rather than timing out.
